info.title: Every Inn Booking Core — internal API
info.description: Provider-owned contract of everyinn-booking-core (EI-OTA-ARCH-001 Phase 1). Internal-only: reachable exclusively through the Admin BFF Service Binding (no workers.dev, no Preview URLs, no routes). Every operation requires X-EI-Caller: admin-bff plus the staff actor headers forwarded by the BFF after JWT/RBAC. Money is integer VND, instants are UTC ISO-8601, business dates are Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Errors: { error: { code, message, request_id, details? } }.

servers.description: Service Binding (env.BOOKING.fetch) — not a public host

x-callers-legend.admin-bff: Admin BFF (everyinn-admin) — the only caller in Phase 1

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scope = operation:caller:actor. Same key + same body → replay (200, replayed=true); same key + different body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. TTL 7 days.

Booking.description: Full internal booking DTO. Never contains door codes or secrets. pricing.isFinal=false while the CDP accrual result is pending (§6.7 rule 4).

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token: send as expectedVersion.

FinancialEntry.description: Append-only manual ledger entry. amount is signed (+ received, − returned); reversals copy the bucket with the opposite sign.

OutboxItem.description: Booking → CDP command (no PII: guest phone is not exposed here).

quote.description: Never final: the stamp reward is advisory until the CDP accrual result (isFinal is always false).

get.summary: Master data: property, rooms, rate rules, booking rules, check-in slots, categories, active promotions (ETag = catalog domain version).

patch.summary: Change base price / extra-hour fee (optimistic expectedVersion). Affects new quotes only; bookings keep their price snapshot.

put.summary: booking_rules (partial merge, unknown keys rejected) | hourly_checkin_slots.

post.summary: Create a promotion. Loyalty tier 'new' is accepted and stored as 'not_member'. Empty arrays mean no restriction.
Legacy-compatible eligibility check for a raw subtotal (business-date + rate-plan aware, tier via CDP when required).

patch.summary: Partial update incl. isActive toggle (expectedVersion). Existing bookings keep their promotion snapshot.

post.summary: Every active room (optionally of one class) with availability, human-readable reasons and base price for a stay.
Server-side quote for one room: base + promotion + ADVISORY loyalty preview (CDP loyalty-context). Degrades to available=false when CDP is down.

get.summary: Legacy filters + paging (pageSize ≤ 50), deterministic order, ETag on the bookings domain version.

post.summary: Create a manual booking: server pricing, atomic two-lane slot claim, promotion redemption (DB usage fence), optional deposit/payment ledger entries, CDP accrual (sync-first + outbox) — one D1 transaction.

get.summary: Booking + ledger + CDP sync state + last 50 audit events (ETag = booking version).

patch.summary: Change room/time/type/guests/notes (expectedVersion). Moves inventory atomically, re-prices, re-evaluates the promotion snapshot (dropPromotion=true to remove it). Phone is immutable.

post.summary: Extend checkout by `hours` (default 1, legacy extend1h): fee from the rate rule, claims occupancy + turnover slots.
pending → confirmed; enqueues the CDP accrual (occurredAt = immutable booking.created_at).
Soft cancel (replaces legacy hard delete): frees inventory, records CDP outcome for counted bookings (no loyalty reversal in mock-v1).
confirmed → no_show before checkout; optional refund ≤ net received (ledger entry in the same transaction).
Re-arms the guest's pending CDP commands (per-guest FIFO) and delivers them now. Safe to repeat (CDP is idempotent).
deposit | payment | refund (≤ net received) | adjustment (signed, manager, reason). Projection updated in the same transaction.
Correction by an opposite entry; each entry is reversible once (DB UNIQUE); reversals are not reversible.

200.description: Rooms with live bookings and active blocks
Check-ins / check-outs of the business date
Deposits due by the business date, not reminded since local midnight

post.summary: Maintenance block: claims the occupancy lane only (may start exactly at a checkout).

patch.summary: Reschedule / reason / note (expectedVersion); slots re-claimed atomically.

post.summary: Soft release (replaces legacy DELETE); frees the slots.

get.summary: Reconciliation view of Booking → CDP commands (default status=dead).

post.summary: Re-arms a dead/pending command (attempts reset) and delivers the guest's queue now.
